narrative:

The relatively short nine-month duration of your requested loan and the modest 1,670 DM amount both worked in your favor, as these are noticeably lower than the averages seen among applicants who were approved. These shorter and smaller requests typically signal lower risk to the bank.

Unfortunately, the status of your checking account pushed the prediction in the opposite direction and ultimately outweighed those positive signals. Your account falls into the 0-200 DM category, which is less common among successfully approved applicants. This appears to have been the decisive element that led the model to classify you as higher risk.

To improve your chances on a future application, focus on strengthening your checking account balance and consider building a longer track record of stable finances before reapplying. You may also want to explore a slightly longer loan term if it better matches your needs, as that could further demonstrate lower risk.
